name: Send Customer ( FmId )
purpose: Public LedgerLink entry that sends one customer to QuickBooks Online: rejects an empty id (QBO.Error 'Missing the Customer Id'), otherwise calls Send FMData To QBO with Entity=Customer and the id, and returns its result.
open_question: All QBO behaviour is in Send FMData To QBO (script 302), outside this share. Called by Send Invoice ( FmId ) (script 456) so a customer is sent before its invoice.
